project.name: run_backtest Decomposition
project.description: Refactor the monolithic run_backtest() into a sequenced pipeline of pure step functions over an explicit PortfolioState frozen dataclass, fixing two GTT LEAPS accounting bugs and enabling atomic unit-testing of each day-step in isolation.
project.overview: run_backtest() in src/finance/portfolio.py is ~400 lines of interleaved mutable state. Two production bugs (LEAPS double-count on re-entry, IV mismatch on re-entry) were both caused by leaps_value being read, overwritten, and re-read within the same loop iteration with no invariant boundary. The redesign introduces PortfolioState (frozen dataclass encapsulating all loop-local state), DayInputs (per-day read-only inputs), and BacktestContext (immutable precomputed config/series). The external run_backtest signature and BacktestResult are frozen. All downstream contracts (metrics.py, figures.py, leverage.py) are unchanged.

data_schemas.name: PortfolioState
data_schemas.description: Immutable snapshot of all mutable per-day loop state. Every mutation produces a new instance via dataclasses.replace(). Accumulators (all_window_ledgers, all_gtt_closes) are tuples to ensure pure step functions.

fields.name: holdings
fields.description: Dollar value per base asset; governed assets zeroed during defensive windows. Dict reference is frozen; step functions construct new dicts.

fields.name: defensive_sleeve
fields.description: Governed equity capital swept in during GTT defensive windows.

fields.name: leaps_pool
fields.description: Force-closed LEAPS net proceeds parked during defensive windows.

fields.name: leaps_value
fields.description: Current LEAPS mark-to-market. Set by _compute_leaps_mtm (suppressed on re-entry days) or overwritten by _apply_gtt_reentry.

fields.name: prev_total_nav
fields.description: End-of-day NAV from t-1; denominator of port_return calculation.

fields.name: prev_regime
fields.description: GTT regime on t-1: 1=Long, 0=Defensive. Drives transition detection.

fields.name: prev_date_ts
fields.description: Trading date of t-1; used for force-close spot/IV lookup on Long->Defensive day.

fields.name: leaps_ledger
fields.description: Active per-window LEAPS simulation ledger; replaced on each GTT re-entry.

fields.name: leaps_scale
fields.description: Surviving fraction per contract after drift partial-closes; keyed by original contract, value in (0, 1].

fields.name: all_window_ledgers
fields.description: Immutable accumulator: one ledger per Long window for final assembly.

fields.name: all_gtt_closes
fields.description: Immutable accumulator: all GTT force-close events across all defensive transitions.

data_schemas.name: DayInputs
data_schemas.description: Per-day read-only inputs extracted from precomputed series before the step pipeline runs. No field contains data with timestamp > date_ts (temporal invariant T1).

fields.name: date_ts
fields.description: Current trading day.

fields.name: day_ret
fields.description: Asset returns for this day, indexed by ticker.

fields.name: regime_t
fields.description: GTT regime for today: 0=Defensive, 1=Long (from mask_aligned).

fields.name: def_gross_return
fields.description: Blended defensive sleeve return for today (0.0 if GTT inactive).

fields.name: spot
fields.description: Underlying LEAPS spot price at date_ts (None if no LEAPS).

fields.name: raw_vix_value
fields.description: Raw VIX at date_ts (None if no vol_prices). Used as creation IV on re-entry.

fields.name: mtm_iv_value
fields.description: 30-day rolling mean VIX at date_ts (None or NaN during 29-day warmup). Used for daily MTM.

fields.name: rfr
fields.description: Risk-free rate at date_ts.

fields.name: is_month_end
fields.description: True if date_ts is the last trading day of a calendar month.

fields.name: is_rebal_date
fields.description: True if date_ts is a scheduled quarterly rebalance date.

data_schemas.name: BacktestContext
data_schemas.description: Immutable per-backtest configuration and precomputed series. Constructed once before the loop. Contains no per-day state (PortfolioState) or per-day scalars (DayInputs).

fields.name: base_assets
fields.description: Asset tickers that are NOT LEAPS carve-outs.

fields.name: leaps_keys
fields.description: Asset keys ending in _LEAPS suffix.

fields.name: leaps_fraction
fields.description: Sum of target weights for leaps_keys; fraction of NAV allocated to LEAPS.

fields.name: base_target_w
fields.description: Normalized weights over base_assets only (sums to 1.0).

fields.name: governed_base
fields.description: Subset of base_assets governed by GTT signal (VTI and any GTT_EQUITY_TICKERS).

fields.name: gtt_active
fields.description: True when gtt_signal is provided and portfolio holds a governed ticker.

fields.name: defensive_weights
fields.description: Weights for the defensive sleeve; may include R_f sentinel key.

fields.name: use_leaps
fields.description: True when any leaps_keys are present in target_weights.

fields.name: iv
fields.description: IV floor: config.leaps_config.iv or DEFAULT_IV.

fields.name: leaps_monthly
fields.description: Monthly contribution fraction allocated to LEAPS.

fields.name: base_contribution
fields.description: Monthly contribution fraction allocated to base holdings.

fields.name: config
fields.description: Full portfolio config; passed through for run_leaps_simulation calls.

fields.name: return_data
fields.description: Return data; passed through for risk_free_rate in run_leaps_simulation.

fields.name: underlying_prices
fields.description: LEAPS underlying spot prices aligned to backtest index.

fields.name: raw_vix
fields.description: Raw VIX series aligned to backtest index (unsmoothed).

fields.name: mtm_iv_series
fields.description: 30-day rolling mean of raw_vix; NaN for first 29 days.

fields.name: rfr_series
fields.description: Risk-free rate series aligned to backtest index.

fields.name: mask_aligned
fields.description: 0/1 GTT position mask aligned to backtest index.

fields.name: def_gross
fields.description: Blended daily defensive sleeve return series.

fields.name: rebal_dates
fields.description: O(1)-lookup set of scheduled quarterly rebalance dates.

fields.name: month_end_dates
fields.description: O(1)-lookup set of last trading days of each calendar month.

fields.name: long_window_end
fields.description: Maps each Long-window start date to its end date; used to slice prices for re-entry LEAPS simulations.

fields.name: w
fields.description: Full target weight Series (including LEAPS keys); used for drift check and weight_row assembly.

api_contracts.name: _build_context
api_contracts.description: Validate all run_backtest inputs and precompute all series and index sets. Contains all current ValueError guards. Returns immutable BacktestContext.
raises: ValueError: if assets missing from return_data
ValueError: if LEAPS underlying absent from price_data
ValueError: if leaps_config is None when LEAPS keys present

api_contracts.name: _build_initial_state
api_contracts.description: Construct the day-0 PortfolioState: deploy initial capital into holdings, run first LEAPS simulation scoped to the first Long window.

api_contracts.name: _extract_day_inputs
api_contracts.description: Pure index lookup: extract per-day scalar values from precomputed series in ctx for the given date. No computation beyond index access and None guards.

api_contracts.name: _apply_gtt_open
api_contracts.description: Sweep governed equity holdings into defensive_sleeve at open of a defensive day. No-op on Long days or when GTT inactive.

api_contracts.name: _apply_gtt_force_close
api_contracts.description: Force-close all live LEAPS contracts on Long->Defensive transition. Appends LeapsGttCloseEvent to all_gtt_closes; adds net_proceeds to leaps_pool. No-op if not a transition day.

api_contracts.name: _apply_returns
api_contracts.description: Compound base holdings by today's asset returns: holdings[a] *= (1 + day_ret[a]) for each base asset.

api_contracts.name: _apply_defensive_compounding
api_contracts.description: Compound defensive_sleeve and leaps_pool by blended defensive return. Fires on defensive days and re-entry day (prev_regime=0). No-op when GTT inactive.

api_contracts.name: _compute_leaps_mtm
api_contracts.description: Mark live LEAPS contracts to market using smoothed MTM IV; stores result in state.leaps_value. Suppressed (leaps_value=0.0) on defensive days and re-entry days (Bug 1 fix: old ledger would return stale contracts). Uses max(mtm_iv_value, ctx.iv) if mtm_iv_value is not NaN; else ctx.iv.

api_contracts.name: _compute_nav_before_contrib
api_contracts.description: Return sum(holdings) + leaps_value + defensive_sleeve + leaps_pool. Pure arithmetic, no mutation. Used as pre-contribution NAV for port_return and contribution sizing.

api_contracts.name: _compute_port_return
api_contracts.description: Return nav_before / prev_total_nav - 1.0. Excludes contributions by design (nav_before is pre-contribution). Pure arithmetic.

api_contracts.name: _apply_contribution
api_contracts.description: Add monthly contribution to holdings on month-end days. Base share proportional to base_target_w. On defensive days: governed-ticker share to defensive_sleeve; LEAPS share to leaps_pool. No-op if not month-end.

api_contracts.name: _apply_rebalance
api_contracts.description: Realign base holdings to base_target_w. QUARTERLY: fires on is_rebal_date, NAV-neutral. DRIFT: fires on is_month_end if drift band breached; also handles LEAPS overshoot via leaps_scale.

api_contracts.name: _apply_gtt_reentry
api_contracts.description: Defensive->Long forced rebalance: redeploy full NAV to target_weights. Step order is load-bearing: (1) compute total, (2) set holdings, (3) zero sleeve/pool, (4) run fresh LEAPS simulation, (5) compute leaps_value at CREATION IV (max(raw_vix_value, ctx.iv)) — NOT smoothed MTM IV (Bug 2 fix). No-op if not a re-entry day.

api_contracts.name: _compute_total_nav
api_contracts.description: Return sum(holdings) + leaps_value + defensive_sleeve + leaps_pool after all mutations. Identical formula to _compute_nav_before_contrib but called post-mutation. Separation makes the pre/post distinction explicit.

api_contracts.name: _build_weight_row
api_contracts.description: Compute end-of-day realized weights for weight_history. Base assets: holdings[a]/total_nav. LEAPS: leaps_value*(w[k]/leaps_fraction)/total_nav. Defensive decomposition: parked*(dw)/total_nav for each defensive_weight.

api_contracts.name: _advance_state
api_contracts.description: Update prev_total_nav, prev_regime, prev_date_ts for next iteration. Only these three fields change; all others carry forward unchanged.

api_contracts.name: _assemble_leaps_ledger
api_contracts.description: Post-loop: freeze leaps_scale into partial_close_events; if GTT+LEAPS active, concatenate all_window_ledgers into one LeapsLedger with gtt_close_events=all_gtt_closes.

api_contracts.name: run_backtest
api_contracts.description: Public orchestrator — thin shell: _build_context -> _build_initial_state -> loop over step functions -> _assemble_leaps_ledger -> BacktestResult. Signature and return type frozen.

risks.description: Mutation through aliased dict: a step function receives state.holdings and mutates it in-place instead of constructing a new dict, silently corrupting the previous PortfolioState. mypy cannot catch this.
risks.mitigation: Code review gate: every step function that produces a new holdings dict must use a dict literal or dict() constructor. Add a mutation-detection fixture in test_portfolio_step_functions.py that deep-copies state before calling each step function and asserts the copy is unchanged after the call.

risks.description: _apply_gtt_reentry reordered before _apply_contribution: if a future developer reorders these calls in run_backtest, NAV on month-end re-entry days changes (contribution would seed into a smaller pre-rebalance total). The ordering is load-bearing.
risks.mitigation: Document the step sequence in run_backtest with an explicit comment block explaining why each step precedes the next. I2 integration invariant (Scenario B) would catch most ordering violations.

risks.description: O(n^2) tuple accumulation: moving all_window_ledgers and all_gtt_closes to PortfolioState as tuples means each append creates a new tuple. O(n^2) in number of windows. Acceptable for typical 2-8 windows over 26 years; not acceptable if windows become frequent.
risks.mitigation: Document the O(n^2) concern in PortfolioState docstring. If window count exceeds ~50 in a future configuration, switch to a mutable list held in a non-frozen accumulator wrapper outside PortfolioState.

risks.description: Month-end re-entry contribution double-count: on a month-end re-entry day, _apply_contribution runs after _apply_gtt_reentry. The interaction between rebalance NAV (computed from pre-contribution total) and the subsequent contribution has never been formally tested.
risks.mitigation: Phase 4b (Scenario B, invariant I2) directly verifies nav[t] == nav[t-1]*(1+r[t]) + contribution[t] for every day including month-end re-entry coincidences.

risks.description: NaN in mtm_iv_value during warmup: mtm_iv_series has NaN for the first 29 days. _compute_leaps_mtm must handle NaN gracefully (fall back to ctx.iv). Absence of this guard causes a TypeError.
risks.mitigation: Preserve existing pd.notna(smoothed) guard in _compute_leaps_mtm. Add explicit unit test for NaN mtm_iv_value input in F-010.

risks.description: Bug 1 suppression removed by future contributor: if _compute_leaps_mtm loses the re-entry suppression condition (prev_regime==0, regime_t==1), Bug 1 recurs silently. The condition is now named and documented but could be considered 'unnecessary' by a reader unfamiliar with the bug history.
risks.mitigation: The A2 atomic invariant test in F-014 (re-entry NAV-neutrality) would catch this: if stale leaps_value is added, sum(holdings)+leaps_value > pre-reentry total. Document the suppression condition with an explicit comment referencing Bug 1.

risks.description: leaps_scale orphaned keys: on GTT re-entry, a fresh leaps_ledger is created but leaps_scale carries forward keys from the previous window. Orphaned keys are never read (live_contracts returns only new-window contracts) but pollute the dict and could confuse future readers.
risks.mitigation: In _apply_gtt_reentry, return a new leaps_scale dict keyed only to contracts in the new ledger. Alternatively, document the orphaned-key behavior as an accepted invariant in PortfolioState docstring.
